name: Electrical and consumer product safety
access: Samples submitted by the manufacturer; factory follow-up inspections.
publication: Mark on product; test reports confidential; listings public.
ai_analogue: Private manufacturer-paid certification ran for roughly ninety years before government accredited the certifiers; a 2007 incident wave made third-party testing mandatory for one product class.

milestones.event: Underwriters Laboratories founded after electrical fires at the 1893 Chicago World's Fair; insurer-linked at origin.
UL publishes its first standard (tin-clad fire doors).
Consumer Product Safety Act creates the CPSC.
OSHA Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratory program accredits third-party labs, ending single-lab dominance.

milestones.trigger_criterion: Certified products found non-compliant; recalls of tens of millions of units

milestones.event: CPSIA requires third-party testing of children's products by CPSC-accepted laboratories.

status: seed; secondary sources; verify each milestone against a primary source before citing in the paper

mechanisms.note: Manufacturer picks and pays an accredited lab; OSHA and CPSC accredit the labs.
